repository.executionRule: Run one targeted meal-grid causal probe from an exact clean descendant of the post-Critic structured-synthesis recovery fix. The product-path preflight seal records the full execution commit. Do not change prompts, retrieval, corpus, provider settings or acceptance rules after observing the answer.

execution.artifactDirectoryRule: Create a fresh directory containing the exact execution commit and UTC timestamp; never overwrite an earlier campaign.

global: The registered meal-grid case produces one mechanically successful row on the same clean commit.
The answer is a complete 5 by 4 grid with 20 distinct concrete source-backed cells; a safe insufficiency does not pass this functional causal probe.
Provider and model telemetry are exactly openai-dev and gpt-5.6-terra; costs and token counts are present.
Tool events must prove the executed initial and complementary or reformulated corpus searches requested by Terra.
If Writer or Critic confuses a SAAIA-created schedule placement with missing documentary evidence, one final bounded synthesis-recovery call may re-evaluate the full supplied evidence.
No internal advanced-evidence-* or internal-source-* identifier may appear in the user-visible result.
No prompt, case, retrieval, corpus, acceptance criterion, local-router binary/model/configuration or runtime parameter changes after the answer is observed.
Any unsupported substantive claim, wrong source relation, budget stop or protocol drift rejects the probe.

A755-ADV-01-meal-grid-5x4: Accept functionally only a complete 5 by 4 grid with 20 distinct concrete cells and evidence supporting each semantic meal-moment placement.
Weekday labels are neutral presentation coordinates and do not require documentary support.

If the corpus cannot prove all 20 semantic placements, accept only a precise insufficiency naming the missing cells or evidence categories; this validates safe behavior but does not close the functional planning gate.

acceptance.productPromotionRule: This targeted causal probe cannot promote the product. Keep TESTE_NON_APPROUVE pending a fresh final 3x campaign, semantic review, blind holdout and authorized external-model gates.

stopRules: Do not execute while the organization dashboard still shows Free tier.
Do not execute without a paid-tier observation less than 15 minutes old.
Stop before the first model call if the branch, clean-tree rule or bank hash differs.
Stop before the first model call if the local llama.cpp runtime, Qwen GGUF or provider configuration hash differs.
Stop before the first model call if the reference corpus cannot be sealed or has queued, running or paused ingestion; reject the campaign if the postflight seal differs.
Let retryable 429 responses use the durable scheduled retry path, bounded to three job attempts and ten minutes per scheduled delay in this campaign.
Stop at the persistent lifetime, per-job or per-job-call budget guard.
Do not start RunPod or transmit the private evidence bundle.
